kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتطأمن (form IIq)
# أَتَطَأْمَنُ (ʔataṭaʔmanu) /ʔa.ta.tˤaʔ.ma.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# أَتَطَأْمَنَ (ʔataṭaʔmana) /ʔa.ta.tˤaʔ.ma.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
# أَتَطَأْمَنْ (ʔataṭaʔman) /ʔa.ta.tˤaʔ.man/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَطَأْمَنَ (taṭaʔmana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
